Cowboy Concierge is Nashville-based, on-demand event and business support designed to help brands, retailers and organizations get more done — with a little Southern hospitality along the way.

From trade shows and store openings to corporate events, retail activations, private gatherings and everything in between, Cowboy Concierge provides friendly, professional and ready-to-work support when and where you need it.

Need an extra set of hands?

Whatever the day throws at you, a Cowboy can take it off your plate:

  • Unloading boxes
  • Welcoming guests at the door
  • Setting up a booth
  • Organizing merchandise
  • Directing attendees
  • Running an errand
  • Keeping an event moving behind the scenes

Or all of the above? That's where we come in.

Our Cowboys aren't just event staff. They're an extension of your team — approachable, dependable and ready to jump in wherever they're needed.

Because sometimes you don't need another vendor. You just need someone who can get it done.

Where can Cowboy Concierge help?

Cowboy Concierge services can be customized based on your event, business or activation, including:

Trade Shows & Conferences

Booth setup, breakdown, product organization, attendee engagement, errands and exhibitor support.

Store Openings & Retail Events

Guest greetings, crowd direction, product support, merchandising assistance and opening-day logistics.

Brand Activations & Pop-Ups

Sampling, giveaways, guest engagement, line management and activation support.

Corporate Events

Registration, guest direction, hospitality, gifting and behind-the-scenes assistance.

Retail Stores

Temporary support during launches, promotions, high-traffic weekends and special events.

Private & VIP Events

Guest assistance, hospitality, gifting, transportation coordination and event support.

Markets, Festivals & Community Events

Vendor assistance, setup, attendee direction and general event support.

Photoshoots & Content Productions

Product handling, errands, setup, talent assistance and on-site support.

Conventions & Nashville Events

Local, reliable support for companies coming into Nashville that need trusted boots on the ground.

Have something else in mind? Just ask.

If it needs an extra pair of capable hands, there's a good chance Cowboy Concierge can help.
